summary: Sandbach United's preseason is in full swing with a competitive friendly against St Helens last weekend showing the squad is taking shape nicely. The club has made some exciting new signings plus welcomed back a returning player for the 2026/27 campaign, and with just one week until the season kicks off, the Ramblers are gearing up for a promotion push in three brand new kits. If you're a local business, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities across various packages.
